summary: 46-year-old local backcountry skier Sean Crossen triggered a 12-15 inch hard slab on a sub-ridge of White Mountain above Copper Creek; carried ~1,350 vertical ft over a ~50-ft cliff band, breaking ribs, nose, ankle, shoulder, and sustaining a compound arm fracture.
location: White Mountain sub-ridge above Copper Creek (via Snodgrass Trailhead)
notes: Article says "last week... morning of Wednesday, February 1"; 2017-02-01 was a Wednesday. Partner Pete Sowar radioed/celled for help; the pair skied down to mile 2.2 of the Copper Creek trail. CBSAR paged ~2:20 p.m., ~10 members, snowmobile + toboggan evacuation via Gothic; ambulance to Gunnison Valley Hospital, then helo to St. Mary's Hospital, Grand Junction. | CAIC classic 2016-17 table dates this Copper Creek/Gothic incident 2017-02-03 (vs the CBN account's 2017-02-01); row date kept at 2017-02-01 per the detailed local account.
